title: Remove the completion_source.dart re-export from mark_completion_use_case.dart
why: coding-standards.md Rule 2 states providers.dart is 'the only sanctioned re-export file... do not add other barrel/re-export files — deep re-export chains defeat "where is X defined?" search'. mark_completion_use_case.dart re-exports a domain entity from an unrelated file. This isn't theoretical: mark_completion_use_case_siyum_routing_test.dart imports only the use-case file and uses CompletionSource entirely via the transitive re-export, demonstrating exactly the defined-where? confusion the rule warns about.
recommendation: Delete the export statement; update the one demonstrated consumer (and any others `dart analyze` surfaces) to import completion_source.dart directly.
acceptance_criteria: mark_completion_use_case.dart has no export statement; all consumers of CompletionSource import completion_source.dart directly; `dart analyze` stays clean.
